images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: conceptual lead illustration for a detailed Chinese robotics blog article about Real-Time Chunking (RTC). Primary request: illustrate a robot continuing its already committed motion while a policy computes a compatible future action chunk in the background. Landscape about 16:9. Style: clean technical editorial illustration matching the site's X-VLA diagrams: white/off-white background, navy typography and outlines, translucent light blue and lavender panels, warm orange for committed actions, teal for new future actions, softly rendered realistic white robot and camera, restrained 3D depth, ample whitespace. Composition: large central tabletop scene with a single white 6-axis robot arm with a parallel gripper moving toward a blue block, a small camera observing the table. Show a short orange dotted motion path close to its current gripper (committed motion), continuing into a teal dotted curve toward the block (future plan), with subtle ghost poses, physically plausible joints. On the upper right a translucent lavender policy-compute inset with stacked neural network layers and small action token tiles, visually separate from the robot motion. Thin directional arrows: camera observation into policy, policy continuation into an action-queue inset below, queue into robot. The action queue is one clean horizontal strip with an orange prefix then teal future tiles; no numbers, no exact timing claim. Use only the following brief English text, exactly: top title 'RTC: Plan While Moving'; camera label 'OBSERVE'; policy label 'PLAN'; robot label 'EXECUTE'; below queue segments 'Committed prefix' and 'New continuation'. Avoid extra text, Chinese text, formulas, axes, brand logos, watermark, comparative performance claims, humanoids, collision hazards, duplicated robots. This is an original conceptual illustration, not a reproduction of a paper figure and not a measured experimental trajectory.
images.role: Concept illustration; not measured trajectory or timing
